findings.detail: Foreign currency symbols in the principal amount column were propagated to cost_currency even though Cost and Fair Value are dollar-denominated schedule valuation columns.

rationale: FX03 is a Class 1 row-validation issue on cost_currency. The raw schedule is headed '(in thousands)' with Cost and Fair Value columns; for foreign-country positions, local currency markers such as AUD, EUR, GBP, and CHF appear in the principal amount/par value column, while the Cost and Fair Value columns aggregate to rows explicitly marked with dollar signs. Therefore non-USD cost_currency values on the flagged BDC valuation rows are source-inconsistent extraction/unit-assignment errors, not valid foreign-currency cost units.
